text: The Fed under Chair Warsh has signaled possible rate hikes in 2026 — not cuts — with markets pricing in two 25bp increases by year-end, which means borrowing costs could rise further and hit unprofitable, cash-burning stocks in your portfolio especially hard.
Sell RGTI now — you're down 45%, revenue is shrinking by 34%, the stock is 73% off its highs, and this unprofitable company faces an even tougher environment if rates rise further.
Sell QBTS — you're down 39% on a cash-burning, unprofitable company that's 62% off its highs, and with rates potentially heading higher, speculative names like this face the most pressure.

Trim IONQ to reduce your exposure — you're down 22%, the company is unprofitable with heavy cash burn and over 10% short interest, and quantum computing stocks need cheap capital to survive, which isn't coming anytime soon.
Raise your BMNR stop from $17.07 to $18.11 to lock in more protection on a stock that's already down 62% from its highs and has missed earnings three times recently.
Consider adding to MU — a PE of just 6.6 with nearly 49% revenue growth and consistent earnings beats makes this one of the best value-plus-growth combinations in your portfolio right now.
Consider adding to GOOGL — trading at a reasonable PE of 22 with 15% revenue growth and insider buying, this is a high-quality name at a fair price even in a higher-rate environment.
Consider adding to UNH — steady 12% revenue growth, a 4.6% free cash flow yield, and insider buying make this a defensive compounder that holds up well when economic growth is slowing.
